# 13 Gypsies

> Intimate Spanish tapas restaurant ("a peasant kitchen") in historic Riverside, Jacksonville, Florida. Seven tables, about twenty seats. Nearly everything is made in house: bread, cheese, sausage, dry-cured meats, pickled veg tables, spice blends and fresh pasta.

- Address: 887 Stockton St, Jacksonville, FL 32204 (corner of College St and Stockton St, right off I-10)
- Phone: (904) 389-0330 · Email: 13g@13gypsies.com
- Hours: Tuesday–Thursday 5–9 PM; Friday–Saturday 5–10 PM; closed Sunday and Monday. Last seating 90 minutes before close.
- Reservations: highly recommended, on OpenTable (https://www.opentable.com/r/13-gypsies-jacksonville) or by phone. Tables are not held for walk-ins.
- Private dining: the whole restaurant can be reserved for an all-inclusive flat rate (food, beverages, room, tax, gratuity). Call for details.
- Chef: Chef Kevan Kimball and crew. Building: 1923 Spanish-style building by architect Henrietta Dozier.
- Ratings: OpenTable 4.9 (691 reviews); Google 4.5 (462 reviews).
- Dress: casual. Parking: street parking. Gluten-free and vegetarian options.

## Pages
- Home: https://rgwebd.github.io/13gypsies-luxe/
- Menu: https://rgwebd.github.io/13gypsies-luxe/menu.html

## Menu (changes often; no prices listed)
- Vegetables: Crispy Potatoes (curried onion sauce); Cauliflower (sautéed with curry sauce and sweet peas); Mushroom Sevilla (cream sherry sauce, goat cheese toast); Roasted Cremini Mushrooms (garlic, rosemary, saffron allioli, sautéed kale); Empanada of Kale (dill buttermilk dressing); Butter Braised Cabbage (brown butter, house kimchi paste); Roasted Brussel Sprouts (bleu cheese sauce, roasted almonds)
- Meat & Seafood: House Made Fresh Chorizo (honey sautéed pear, warm spiced dates); Mongolian Beef (honey-soy dipping sauce); Pork Belly Mojo (house cultured crema); Octopus Pil-Pil (olive oil, garlic, chilies, parsley, lemon allioli, baguette); Sautéed Argentinian Red Shrimp (two-hour sofrito, brown butter, baguette)
- Cold: Honey Garlic Hummus (flatbread, clover honey); House Made Ricotta (smoked honey, grilled peasant bread); Tomato and Cucumber Salad (couscous, citronette, dill whipped feta, pickled red onion); Zanahorias (Moroccan spiced carrots, pickled sultanas, cilantro, roasted almonds, olive oil)
- Pasta: Roman Style Gnocchi (beef and mushroom stock, butter, pecorino); Spaghetti all’Assassina (lots of red chili flakes and garlic, tomato passata, cherry tomatoes, house made ricotta. Limit one per table.)
- Daily Offerings: Risotto (ask about tonight’s risotto); From the Chamber (true, in-house, handcrafted, dry cured meat, peasant bread); Peasant Bread (house made bread served with olive oil)
